The Pacers defeated the Grizzlies, 107-103 tonight in Memphis. Andrew Nembhard finished with a team-high 22 points along with 4 assists and 2 rebounds for the Pacers, while Pascal Siakam tallied 20 points, 5 rebounds and 2 steals in the game. Ty Jerome recorded 23 points, 4 rebounds and 3 assists. The Pacers improve their record to 3-6 with the win, while the Grizzlies fall to 6-2 for the season.
